findings.statement: not writing the index slack is worth measuring on a bulk load
findings.detail: 1560202 ops/s leaving the slack a hole against 1547126 writing it (hole vs written: NO DIFFERENCE (ratio 1.008, p=0.8345) -- within noise, not a result)

findings.statement: the two arms produce the same file size
findings.detail: 9084944 bytes against 9084944 bytes, with 8175616 against 9072640 sent to the device. The apparent size is identical because the slack is reserved either way; the difference is a hole, which file size cannot see and /proc/self/io can

notes: both arms interleaved in one process; the only difference is Options::write_index_slack
